verdict.rationale: Zapier documents that outside parties can build integrations for their own products with the Platform CLI or Visual Builder and publish them to the App Directory, where Zapier users can then use them. MCP tool bundles can also be shared so others add them to their own server. This is mainly a vendor-publisher model, though, not an open community marketplace with an explicit install flow. Missing for 10: evidence of community (non-vendor-of-the-app) contributors publishing integrations, an explicit install/add mechanism for third-party integrations, review/trust process for contributed integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
